observations: Photo 0: A bare engine assembly (no visible transmission) sitting on ground/stand, surrounded by other car parts and vehicles in a yard.
Photo 0: Loose wiring harness with exposed red and black wire ends visible at bottom, suggesting a cut harness.
Photo 0: A seatbelt webbing/strap is wrapped around the engine, likely used to hold it upright for photographing, not a vehicle part.
Photo 1: Close-up of plastic engine cover reading 'AUDI' with four-ring logo and 'TFSI' lettering.
Photo 1: Turbocharger inlet pipe, injector wiring, and various hoses visible, consistent with a VW/Audi TFSI inline engine.
Photo 2: Another angle of the same engine showing alternator, belt, and injector rail; general dust/grime but no visible major cracks.
No visible engine code plate, no VIN tag, no odometer, no start-up evidence, no oil/coolant condition visible, no dyno or compression test shown.

claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim about seller's inventory; no photo evidence of other stock or shopfront.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, timing, bearings)
risks.proof: Video of engine starting and running, or compression test readout

risks.risk: Wiring harness appears cut (exposed red/black wires in photo 0), may be missing ECU or key components
risks.proof: Close-up photo of harness connectors and confirmation ECU/key is included
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, harness/ECU not included

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement/turbo spec unknown, which drives value significantly among TFSI variants
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code stamped on block or a parts/ID sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest-spec TFSI used engine range

risks.proof: Photo of odometer from donor car or service record
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-mileage used engine (worst case, high mileage assumed)

risks.risk: Ancillaries (turbo, alternator, injectors) may not be included in sale or may be damaged
risks.proof: Full 360° video showing all ancillaries attached and seller confirming what's included
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, ancillaries not guaranteed

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and idling with audible sound
Close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block
Photo of wiring harness connectors and confirmation ECU/key included
Photo of odometer or any paperwork indicating mileage/origin
Confirmation list of exactly which parts are included in the sale (turbo, alternator, injectors, etc.)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Audi TFSI engine from the cover badge, but with no running proof, cut-looking harness, and no engine code visible, it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly incomplete pulled engine until further proof is supplied.
